S.FORM: R uxe cbeyo a ita wa meepah R meepahta klaali kesaota ho.
S.PHON: ɾ uxe ʦbejo a ita wa meepaħ ɾ meepaħta klaali kesaota ħo
S.FORM: R uxe cbeyo a ita wa meepah R meepahta klaali kesaota ho.
S.PHON: ɾ uxe ʦbejo a ita wa meepaħ ɾ meepaħta klaali kesaota ħo
S.TRANSL: 不是...我們以前工作.我們來跟他說我們以前每天工作.
No...we worked in the past. Let's tell him we used to work every day.

S.FORM: B a cbeyo na.
S.PHON: b a ʦbejo na
S.FORM: B a cbeyo na.
S.PHON: b a ʦbejo na
S.TRANSL: 過去的時候.
In the past.

S.FORM: R XXXX cbeyo a meepahta klaali ita na R a inita gduru ma.
S.PHON: ɾ xxxx ʦbejo a meepaħta klaali ita na ɾ a inita gduɾu ma
S.FORM: R XXXX cbeyo a meepahta klaali ita na R a inita gduru ma.
S.PHON: ɾ xxxx ʦbejo a meepaħta klaali ita na ɾ a inita gduɾu ma
S.TRANSL: 從前我們每天工作,而且我們不休息.
In the past, we worked every day, and we did not take a rest.

S.FORM: R ma musata meepah R kika pneyahta neepah dungan ma mapata qhuni.
S.PHON: ɾ ma musata meepaħ ɾ kika pnejaħta neepaħ duŋan ma mapata qħuni
S.FORM: R ma musata meepah R kika pneyahta neepah dungan ma mapata qhuni.
S.PHON: ɾ ma musata meepaħ ɾ kika pnejaħta neepaħ duŋan ma mapata qħuni
S.TRANSL: 而且我們去工作,回來的時候,我們又背木材.
And we went to work. On our way back, we carried woods on our back.

S.FORM: R te mapata laqi uri R apaanun hiya ka laqi R apaanun bobo qhuni ka laqi.
S.PHON: ɾ te mapata laqi uɾi ɾ apaanun ħija ka laqi ɾ apaanun bobo qħuni ka laqi
S.FORM: R te mapata laqi uri R apaanun hiya ka laqi R apaanun bobo qhuni ka laqi.
S.PHON: ɾ te mapata laqi uɾi ɾ apaanun ħija ka laqi ɾ apaanun bobo qħuni ka laqi
S.TRANSL: 我們還要背小孩,小孩背在那裡,在木材上.
We carried children on our back as well, carrying children there on the woord

S.FORM: R e meyahta sapah dungan mtahuta puniq.
S.PHON: ɾ e mejaħta sapaħ duŋan mtaħuta puniq
S.FORM: R e meyahta sapah dungan mtahuta puniq.
S.PHON: ɾ e mejaħta sapaħ duŋan mtaħuta puniq
S.TRANSL: 我們回家,又要生火.
We came home and we made fire.

S.FORM: R pureta oyu R pureta ido R t a trimata laqi.
S.PHON: ɾ puɾeta oju ɾ puɾeta ido ɾ t a tɾimata laqi
S.FORM: R pureta oyu R pureta ido R t a trimata laqi.
S.PHON: ɾ puɾeta oju ɾ puɾeta ido ɾ t a tɾimata laqi
S.TRANSL: (然後)我們煮洗澡水和煮飯.我們給小孩洗澡.
And then we boil water and cooked rice. We bathed the children.

FORM.notes: source note: ga taqi ka heya「他正在睡覺」。

S.FORM: R na un ma kika R laqi ma taqita R kika uqulun ido laqi han ma R kika taqi bobona.
S.PHON: ɾ na un ma kika ɾ laqi ma taqita ɾ kika uqulun ido laqi ħan ma ɾ kika taqi bobona
S.FORM: R na un ma kika R laqi ma taqita R kika uqulun ido laqi han ma R kika taqi bobona.
S.PHON: ɾ na un ma kika ɾ laqi ma taqita ɾ kika uqulun ido laqi ħan ma ɾ kika taqi bobona
S.TRANSL: 是這樣,小孩去睡覺,之前,我們給小孩子餵飯.然後小孩睡覺.
Yes, children went to sleep, and before that we fed children first. Then children slept.

S.FORM: R so kiya ka kurusi R so kiya a R so kiya ka ndaannami cbeyo.
S.PHON: ɾ so kija ka kuɾusi ɾ so kija a ɾ so kija ka ndaannami ʦbejo
S.FORM: R so kiya ka kurusi R so kiya a R so kiya ka ndaannami cbeyo.
S.PHON: ɾ so kija ka kuɾusi ɾ so kija a ɾ so kija ka ndaannami ʦbejo
S.TRANSL: 就是像那樣辛苦.那就是從前的經歷.
It was like that hard. That was our experience in the past.

S.FORM: R X B henu han robo.
S.PHON: ɾ x b ħenu ħan ɾobo
S.FORM: R X B henu han robo.
S.PHON: ɾ x b ħenu ħan ɾobo
S.TRANSL: Robo,那件事.
Robo, that thing.

FORM.notes: source note: smbarux還工；sntuku pila賺錢；sntuku借工。

S.FORM: R kiya X B a henu han robo mssbaruxta klaali han ma.
S.PHON: ɾ kija x b a ħenu ħan ɾobo mssbaɾuxta klaali ħan ma
S.FORM: R kiya X B a henu han robo mssbaruxta klaali han ma.
S.PHON: ɾ kija x b a ħenu ħan ɾobo mssbaɾuxta klaali ħan ma
S.TRANSL: 我們以前常常會交換工作.
We often exchanged labors in the past.

S.FORM: R un kiya kiya B a B msbaruxta klaali qnburung kosuy han.
S.PHON: ɾ un kija kija b a b msbaɾuxta klaali qnbuɾuŋ kosuj ħan
S.FORM: R un kiya kiya B a B msbaruxta klaali qnburung kosuy han.
S.PHON: ɾ un kija kija b a b msbaɾuxta klaali qnbuɾuŋ kosuj ħan
S.TRANSL: 我們常常割香茅草還工.
We often sheared lemon grass in return.

FORM.notes: source note: hbaro用在很多人的情況。

S.FORM: R un B a B musata kn a B kika smbarux hbaro seediq qnburung kosuy ma.
S.PHON: ɾ un b a b musata kn a b kika smbaɾux ħbaɾo seediq qnbuɾuŋ kosuj ma
S.FORM: R un B a B musata kn a B kika smbarux hbaro seediq qnburung kosuy ma.
S.PHON: ɾ un b a b musata kn a b kika smbaɾux ħbaɾo seediq qnbuɾuŋ kosuj ma
S.TRANSL: 很多人互相幫忙收割香茅草.
Many people helped each other shear lemon grass.

S.FORM: B akedu bale a B mata dekiru ciida robo ha kteetu a.
S.PHON: b akedu bale a b mata dekiɾu ʦiida ɾobo ħa kteetu a
S.FORM: B akedu bale a B mata dekiru ciida robo ha kteetu a.
S.PHON: b akedu bale a b mata dekiɾu ʦiida ɾobo ħa kteetu a
S.TRANSL: Robo,我們那時候怎麼能那樣?
Robo, how could we do that at that time?

S.FORM: R un kiya han B mkesa ini taapa rulu uri naqah elu duri ma.
S.PHON: ɾ un kija ħan b mkesa ini taapa ɾulu uɾi naqaħ elu duɾi ma
S.FORM: R un kiya han B mkesa ini taapa rulu uri naqah elu duri ma.
S.PHON: ɾ un kija ħan b mkesa ini taapa ɾulu uɾi naqaħ elu duɾi ma
S.TRANSL: 我們走上坡路.我們沒辦法搭車,路又很糟.
We walked on slopes. We could not take a car, and the road was lousy.

S.FORM: B a B ma uxe bale kangtang kiya di a.
S.PHON: b a b ma uxe bale kaŋtaŋ kija di a
S.FORM: B a B ma uxe bale kangtang kiya di a.
S.PHON: b a b ma uxe bale kaŋtaŋ kija di a
S.TRANSL: 那真的不簡單.
That was really not easy.

S.FORM: B ukata kucu duri cbeyo a.
S.PHON: b ukata kuʦu duɾi ʦbejo a
S.FORM: B ukata kucu duri cbeyo a.
S.PHON: b ukata kuʦu duɾi ʦbejo a
S.TRANSL: 以前也沒有鞋子.
There were no shoes in the past, either

S.FORM: B musa a meepah na R hadasi R hadasi na B hadasi duri.
S.PHON: b musa a meepaħ na ɾ ħadasi ɾ ħadasi na b ħadasi duɾi
S.FORM: B musa a meepah na R hadasi R hadasi na B hadasi duri.
S.PHON: b musa a meepaħ na ɾ ħadasi ɾ ħadasi na b ħadasi duɾi
S.TRANSL: 我們赤腳去工作.
We went to work barefoot.

S.FORM: B cbeyo riyung kii han na.
S.PHON: b ʦbejo ɾijuŋ kii ħan na
S.FORM: B cbeyo riyung kii han na.
S.PHON: b ʦbejo ɾijuŋ kii ħan na
S.TRANSL: 那是更早以前.
That was even farther in the past.

S.FORM: R un B ma wano kosuy tikuh a henu han bobona de kika mhumata kesaba di ma.
S.PHON: ɾ un b ma wano kosuj tikuħ a ħenu ħan bobona de kika mħumata kesaba di ma
S.FORM: R un B ma wano kosuy tikuh a henu han bobona de kika mhumata kesaba di ma.
S.PHON: ɾ un b ma wano kosuj tikuħ a ħenu ħan bobona de kika mħumata kesaba di ma
S.TRANSL: 只有香茅草一點點那個,所以之後我們就種木薯.
Only lemon grass was a little..., so we grew cassavas afterwards.

S.FORM: R un R kesaba B uhinta tikuh cikau laqi de i bale ba kesaba ninenkang na.
S.PHON: ɾ un ɾ kesaba b uħinta tikuħ ʦikau laqi de i bale ba kesaba ninenkaŋ na
S.FORM: R un R kesaba B uhinta tikuh cikau laqi de i bale ba kesaba ninenkang na.
S.PHON: ɾ un ɾ kesaba b uħinta tikuħ ʦikau laqi de i bale ba kesaba ninenkaŋ na
S.TRANSL: 為了孩子的花費,我們努力工作.木薯每兩年才收成一次.
We worked as hard as possible so as to earn children's allowance. We could only harvest cassavas once in two years.

S.FORM: R un B ga inu ukata naq pila di ma ha tame na laqi gako di ma R ppuuyas laqi do.
S.PHON: ɾ un b ga inu ukata naq pila di ma ħa tame na laqi gako di ma ɾ ppuujas laqi do
S.FORM: R un B ga inu ukata naq pila di ma ha tame na laqi gako di ma R ppuuyas laqi do.
S.PHON: ɾ un b ga inu ukata naq pila di ma ħa tame na laqi gako di ma ɾ ppuujas laqi do
S.TRANSL: 讓孩子念書.
Let children study.

S.FORM: B wadata kariun icineng bale di na.
S.PHON: b wadata kaɾiun iʦineŋ bale di na
S.FORM: B wadata kariun icineng bale di na.
S.PHON: b wadata kaɾiun iʦineŋ bale di na
S.TRANSL: 真的我們沒有錢.為了讓小孩去學校讀書,我們一年就挖了.
We really had no money. To let children study at school, we dug (the cassavas) in only one year.

S.FORM: B musata um R kurusi kmari kesaba na.
S.PHON: b musata um ɾ kuɾusi kmaɾi kesaba na
S.FORM: B musata um R kurusi kmari kesaba na.
S.PHON: b musata um ɾ kuɾusi kmaɾi kesaba na
S.TRANSL: 挖木薯很辛苦.
Digging cassavas was toilsome.

S.FORM: B un mata kariunta kesaba ma kika B phidounta han ma kika R kika R kika baruyunna cusacu laqi B cusacu laqi na.
S.PHON: b un mata kaɾiunta kesaba ma kika b pħidounta ħan ma kika ɾ kika ɾ kika baɾujunna ʦusaʦu laqi b ʦusaʦu laqi na
S.FORM: B un mata kariunta kesaba ma kika B phidounta han ma kika R kika R kika baruyunna cusacu laqi B cusacu laqi na.
S.PHON: b un mata kaɾiunta kesaba ma kika b pħidounta ħan ma kika ɾ kika ɾ kika baɾujunna ʦusaʦu laqi b ʦusaʦu laqi na
S.TRANSL: 是,我們挖木薯,然後先曬乾.然後賣掉讓小孩學校註冊.
Yes, we dug cassavas and then sun-dried them first. And sold them to register children at school.

FORM.notes: source note: 這裡是指沒有錢。

S.FORM: R un B a muhinta han ukata naq a R un B km maemotteta kmbarux han duri ma.
S.PHON: ɾ un b a muħinta ħan ukata naq a ɾ un b km maemotteta kmbaɾux ħan duɾi ma
S.FORM: R un B a muhinta han ukata naq a R un B km maemotteta kmbarux han duri ma.
S.PHON: ɾ un b a muħinta ħan ukata naq a ɾ un b km maemotteta kmbaɾux ħan duɾi ma
S.TRANSL: 我們很努力.我們沒有,我們先借.
We made effort. We didn't have and we borrowed it in advance.

S.FORM: B wata hmuwa suku ciida ha.
S.PHON: b wata ħmuwa suku ʦiida ħa
S.FORM: B wata hmuwa suku ciida ha.
S.PHON: b wata ħmuwa suku ʦiida ħa
S.TRANSL: 我們當時怎麼能那樣生活?
How could we live that way at that time?

S.FORM: B lngelungunmu duri we B ini asi B maanu cbeyo duri msbaruxta ma R lngelungun saya.
S.PHON: b lŋeluŋunmu duɾi we b ini asi b maanu ʦbejo duɾi msbaɾuxta ma ɾ lŋeluŋun saja
S.FORM: B lngelungunmu duri we B ini asi B maanu cbeyo duri msbaruxta ma R lngelungun saya.
S.PHON: b lŋeluŋunmu duɾi we b ini asi b maanu ʦbejo duɾi msbaɾuxta ma ɾ lŋeluŋun saja
S.TRANSL: 我現在想起來.
Now I think.

S.FORM: B inita bari B siyang uri wano naq qcurux mremun mremun B uqiun na B masu ini bari siyang di.
S.PHON: b inita baɾi b sijaŋ uɾi wano naq qʦuɾux mɾemun mɾemun b uqiun na b masu ini baɾi sijaŋ di
S.FORM: B inita bari B siyang uri wano naq qcurux mremun mremun B uqiun na B masu ini bari siyang di.
S.PHON: b inita baɾi b sijaŋ uɾi wano naq qʦuɾux mɾemun mɾemun b uqiun na b masu ini baɾi sijaŋ di
S.TRANSL: 我現在想:＂我們以前怎麼回事?＂我們換工,也不買豬肉,只吃鹹魚.為什麼你不買豬肉?
Now I think, "What was wrong in the past?" We exchanged labors. We did not buy pork and only ate salty fish. Why didn't you buy pork?

S.FORM: R qcurux mremun uqiun nanaq ma.
S.PHON: ɾ qʦuɾux mɾemun uqiun nanaq ma
S.FORM: R qcurux mremun uqiun nanaq ma.
S.PHON: ɾ qʦuɾux mɾemun uqiun nanaq ma
S.TRANSL: 我們只有吃鹹魚.
We only ate salty fish.

S.FORM: B iniku maanu R maanu di B ini kela ini kela mekan siyang na cbeyo.
S.PHON: b iniku maanu ɾ maanu di b ini kela ini kela mekan sijaŋ na ʦbejo
S.FORM: B iniku maanu R maanu di B ini kela ini kela mekan siyang na cbeyo.
S.PHON: b iniku maanu ɾ maanu di b ini kela ini kela mekan sijaŋ na ʦbejo
S.TRANSL: 我們以前不知道要吃豬肉.
We could not buy pork in the past.

S.FORM: R kuromane na R inita bari siyang.
S.PHON: ɾ kuɾomane na ɾ inita baɾi sijaŋ
S.FORM: R kuromane na R inita bari siyang.
S.PHON: ɾ kuɾomane na ɾ inita baɾi sijaŋ
S.TRANSL: 我們之前不買豬肉.
We did not buy pork before.

S.FORM: B mesa tumun R kuromame.
S.PHON: b mesa tumun ɾ kuɾomame
S.FORM: B mesa tumun R kuromame.
S.PHON: b mesa tumun ɾ kuɾomame
S.TRANSL: Tumun說我們就像豆豉.
Tumun said we were like fermented soy beans.

S.FORM: B dqeras gaga B kelaunmu ini ekan siyang si tumun baisurin ado kmukan heya na.
S.PHON: b dqeɾas gaga b kelaunmu ini ekan sijaŋ si tumun baisuɾin ado kmukan ħeja na
S.FORM: B dqeras gaga B kelaunmu ini ekan siyang si tumun baisurin ado kmukan heya na.
S.PHON: b dqeɾas gaga b kelaunmu ini ekan sijaŋ si tumun baisuɾin ado kmukan ħeja na
S.TRANSL: Baisurin的Tumun說:＂我知道沒吃豬肉的人.＂因為他自己是閩南人.
Tumun, who was from Baisurin, said, "I know who does not eat pork," because he was Southern Min.

S.FORM: R a B msresung dqeras hari hayan ini ekan siyang di.
S.PHON: ɾ a b msɾesuŋ dqeɾas ħaɾi ħajan ini ekan sijaŋ di
S.FORM: R a B msresung dqeras hari hayan ini ekan siyang di.
S.PHON: ɾ a b msɾesuŋ dqeɾas ħaɾi ħajan ini ekan sijaŋ di
S.TRANSL: 如果你沒吃豬肉,臉會乾癟.
If you don't eat pork, the face will be shriveled.

S.FORM: R B yamu seediq a ma B a B dqeras mndengu di ini ekan siyang kesai ya na tumun na.
S.PHON: ɾ b jamu seediq a ma b a b dqeɾas mndeŋu di ini ekan sijaŋ kesai ja na tumun na
S.FORM: R B yamu seediq a ma B a B dqeras mndengu di ini ekan siyang kesai ya na tumun na.
S.PHON: ɾ b jamu seediq a ma b a b dqeɾas mndeŋu di ini ekan sijaŋ kesai ja na tumun na
S.TRANSL: ＂你們賽德克人不吃豬肉,所以臉很乾.＂Tumun說.
"You Seediq people's face is dry, because you do not eat pork," Tumun said.

S.FORM: R a R a R un B XXXX bale ba ini ekan siyang han.
S.PHON: ɾ a ɾ a ɾ un b xxxx bale ba ini ekan sijaŋ ħan
S.FORM: R a R a R un B XXXX bale ba ini ekan siyang han.
S.PHON: ɾ a ɾ a ɾ un b xxxx bale ba ini ekan sijaŋ ħan
S.TRANSL: 真的,沒吃豬肉的臉就乾乾的.
That's true. The faces of those who did not eat pork were dry.

S.FORM: R X B ini kela mari siyang cbeyo maanu kana ke.
S.PHON: ɾ x b ini kela maɾi sijaŋ ʦbejo maanu kana ke
S.FORM: R X B ini kela mari siyang cbeyo maanu kana ke.
S.PHON: ɾ x b ini kela maɾi sijaŋ ʦbejo maanu kana ke
S.TRANSL: 我們從前不知道要買豬肉.
We did not know to buy pork.

S.FORM: R kiya ka R kiya ka X B kerung tikuh han B haan psbegu duri ma.
S.PHON: ɾ kija ka ɾ kija ka x b keɾuŋ tikuħ ħan b ħaan psbegu duɾi ma
S.FORM: R kiya ka R kiya ka X B kerung tikuh han B haan psbegu duri ma.
S.PHON: ɾ kija ka ɾ kija ka x b keɾuŋ tikuħ ħan b ħaan psbegu duɾi ma
S.TRANSL: 我們只好拿佛手柑煮湯.
We could only cook soup with chayote.

FORM.notes: source note: sama bale指「山萵苣」。

S.FORM: R sama bale B sama bale maanu qcurux mremun ma R qcurux mremun psbegu na.
S.PHON: ɾ sama bale b sama bale maanu qʦuɾux mɾemun ma ɾ qʦuɾux mɾemun psbegu na
S.FORM: R sama bale B sama bale maanu qcurux mremun ma R qcurux mremun psbegu na.
S.PHON: ɾ sama bale b sama bale maanu qʦuɾux mɾemun ma ɾ qʦuɾux mɾemun psbegu na
S.TRANSL: 我們用山萵苣和鹹魚煮湯.
We used wild lettuce and salty fish to cook soup.

S.FORM: B saya de i i ini puqi qcurux mremun saya da taq naqah qitaan di na.
S.PHON: b saja de i i ini puqi qʦuɾux mɾemun saja da taq naqaħ qitaan di na
S.FORM: B saya de i i ini puqi qcurux mremun saya da taq naqah qitaan di na.
S.PHON: b saja de i i ini puqi qʦuɾux mɾemun saja da taq naqaħ qitaan di na
S.TRANSL: 現在的人就不吃鹹魚.被看到不好.
People do not eat salty fish nowadays. It's not good to look at.

S.FORM: B kii kesaun maku a B anaq so kiya mbeyaxta riyung peni robo ani ini ekan abura na.
S.PHON: b kii kesaun maku a b anaq so kija mbejaxta ɾijuŋ peni ɾobo ani ini ekan abuɾa na
S.FORM: B kii kesaun maku a B anaq so kiya mbeyaxta riyung peni robo ani ini ekan abura na.
S.PHON: b kii kesaun maku a b anaq so kija mbejaxta ɾijuŋ peni ɾobo ani ini ekan abuɾa na
S.TRANSL: 我認為,Robo,雖然我們不吃油,但還是很有力量.
